x: Front page: Through bushes and briars Matthew Hillier storms to the first of his two league wins, this one at a muddy Lloyd Park on January 9th.
Matthew Hillier won two races with Adam Jones and Gavin Mason winning the other two. This, with good back-up from the Boys, ensured that we won with ease.
Finally, a special mention Juniors Matthew Hillier and Wesley Swaffer who gained valuable points in the steeplechase. With their help we moved to a clear 2nd spot in the league.
